MECP Cartesian gradient and reaction-coordinate definitions
Workflow mode = MECP_ONLY
Run mode = CLUSTER

Low-spin multiplicity  = 3 (triplet)
High-spin multiplicity = 5 (quintet)

Definitions:
surface_gradient_difference_cart = g_LS - g_HS
reverse_surface_gradient_difference_cart = g_HS - g_LS
GRADIENT_GAP_NORM_EH_PER_BOHR = ||g_LS - g_HS||
CARTESIAN_GEOMETRIC_MEAN_GRADIENT_EH_PER_BOHR = sqrt(||g_LS|| * ||g_HS||)
The final reaction-coordinate-projected gradient measure is calculated later and is not defined in Step 4.
